recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-10304 unless PA opens a new issue to replace OrganizationAffiliation with a nested Organization element or to rename the resource again.
issue_request: FHIR-10304 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification PA change request asking to add Organization.affiliation for Organization relationships, similar to PractitionerRole, with relationship type, period, and an organization/manager reference. Its final resolution said the new OrganizationAssociation resource had been approved and was more extensive than the original request.
initial_application: Git commit 0b2790895e9de4db72ee18820200e9be7fee6c66 explicitly cites GF#10304 with GF#14413 and GF#14879. It replaced the draft OrganizationRole resource with OrganizationAffiliation in fhir.ini, added OrganizationAffiliation source, examples, terminology, narrative, and spreadsheet inputs, and moved organizationrole to the removed-resource list.
additional_context: The current build uses OrganizationAffiliation rather than the older OrganizationAssociation wording in the Jira resolution. fhir.ini lists organizationaffiliation as an active PA resource with normative status and organizationrole only as removed. Current Organization and OrganizationAffiliation source describes a separate resource for non-hierarchical relationships between distinct organizations, with period, organization, participatingOrganization, code, services, contacts, and endpoints. The Jira-linked Zulip thread supports the separate-resource solution, and related same-commit issues FHIR-14413 and FHIR-14879 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding Organization.affiliation now would contradict the applied PA resolution and duplicate the active OrganizationAffiliation resource.
